messages:
Diego (PM): Quick check-in from today's all-hands Q&A 
Can we get concrete owners/dates for: API rate-limit tiers, Console per-route metrics, and Optimize recommendation preview? Need to sync on customer comms and SDK changes.
Samira (CTO): TL;DR  API tiers internal pilot: Aug 12; external beta: Sep 25. Console per-route metrics beta: Oct 14. Optimize recommendations preview: Nov 4. I'll post calendar invites for milestone reviews.
Alex Kim: For SDKs: will we add new response fields or change endpoints? Need to know for semver.
Samira (CTO): No endpoint changes. We will add optional headers and a beta response block `optimize_suggestions` for preview. Semantic minor bump only. @Alex Kim we will tag PRs.
Marie Chen: Customer comms: can we align on a single one-pager + changelog snippet? CS needs lead time for customers on Enterprise plans.
Liam (Customer Success): Please include upgrade path for Dedicated customers and any migration steps for per-route overrides.
Priya (Eng Lead): Action: engineering to produce migration guide draft by Aug 20. Owner: Priya. It will include sample configs and SDK snippets.
Jordan (SRE): Operational question: when we flip tiers, what's the default behavior for existing accounts? Immediate enforcement or grandfathered?
Samira (CTO): Default = grandfather existing accounts onto current limits for 30 days, then opt-in or auto-migrate with notice. We'll add a feature flag for staggered rollout.
Diego (PM): Can we add a changelog entry that lists opt-in windows and flag names?
Marie Chen: Yes — comms team will draft. Owner: Marie. Due Aug 22.
release-bot: deploy alert: console-metrics-pipeline canary started 2024-08-05T15:00:00Z
Jordan (SRE): Canary threshold: abort if event_drop_rate > 3% or latency spike > 200ms p95.
Priya (Eng Lead): Canary config (for internal runbook):
```
canary:
  traffic_ratio: 0.08
  duration_hours: 72
  abort_if:
    - event_drop_rate >= 0.03
    - p95_latency_increase_ms >= 200
```
Diego (PM): Optimize preview: will suggestions include estimated $/1000 tokens savings?
Priya (Eng Lead): Yes estimates will include cost delta, expected latency delta, and a confidence score. Manual apply only in preview.
Alex Kim: Will the Optimize UI include a downloadable CSV of suggestions for customers?
Priya (Eng Lead): Yes, export CSV in Beta.
Samira (CTO): Action items recap:
- Priya: migration guide draft by Aug 20
- Marie: comms one-pager + changelog draft by Aug 22
- Alex: SDK spec review once Samira shares header/response fields (Samira to send today)
- Jordan: finalize canary abort criteria and runbook by Aug 10
- Diego: assemble customer FAQ draft by Aug 18
Diego (PM): I'll track these in the product board and ping owners. Thanks everyone.
Liam (Customer Success): I'll prep a customer advisory list for early partners; please tag me on comms drafts.
Samira (CTO): Solid. We'll confirm in next leadership sync. :calendar:
